title: Garrett Graff's UFO debunking book after the Aspen Institute pre-bunking

tellings.quote: Garett graph comes out with a book on UFOs earlier this year called UFO and it's basically just a debunking of all these cases

plain: The journalist Garrett Graff published a book called UFO that is "basically just a debunking of all these cases," says the journalist Michael Shellenberger, who dates it to earlier in 2024. He ties it to "pre-bunking," arguing against a claim before it comes out, at the Aspen Institute, a policy think tank, and names a woman called Vivian Schiller alongside it, which would mean the book was part of an effort to shape opinion ahead of new UFO claims.
